The flicker is one dropout of 4 ticks (DROP_TICKS in react.gd) at most in each `period_ticks` (40: 1.5 a second a fighter), so two worn fighters stay inside the screen's three flashes a second (Legal k05, docs/vfx/flash-registry.md).
